blockingIssues.description: Live quality/start preflight still returns HTTP 500 when the active tier is missing from `subscription_tier_limits`, so a fresh DEV-auth local stack fails with `Invalid subscription tier: free` instead of surfacing the promised actionable launch/quality rejection.

Overdue one-shot schedules still call `start_stream()` after their configured `scheduled_stop_time` has already passed, so a delayed scheduler wake-up can briefly launch outside the requested window before the stop pass catches up.

Conflicting live reschedules are rejected using only the persisted DB `stream.status`, so a stale row can allow a future schedule to be saved onto a stream that is still actively running in supervisor/systemd.

Repeated status polls can downgrade an auto-restart candidate from `error` back to `stopped` while leaving `runtime_next_restart_at` populated, which removes the row from `restart_due_streams()` and silently loses the queued recovery.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented the requirement for migrated and seeded `subscription_tier_limits` data during local runtime quality/start verification in `.factory/library/environment.md`.
Documented the built-in DEV-auth fallback identity used when `DEV_USER_EMAIL` and `DEV_USER_ID` are unset.
